ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 Ti OC Edition 8GB GDDR7 Graphics Card

Deliver exceptional frame rates and AI-accelerated rendering power with the next-generation ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 Ti OC Edition 8GB GDDR7 graphics card, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered on NVIDIA's high-efficiency next-gen architecture, this powerful GPU features 8GB of ultra-fast dedicated GDDR7 memory to handle intensive AAA gaming and modern creative workloads seamlessly. The compact multi-slot design ensures high compatibility with standard and mid-tower system setups, while dual premium Axial-tech fans focus downward airflow onto the heatsink for superior thermal regulation. Outfitted with double ball fan bearings for maximum durability and automated Auto-Extreme construction, this factory-overclocked edition guarantees high reliability under prolonged heavy loads. This premium mainstream graphics layout is officially backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
